title: Arch Manning, Jeremiah Smith and 2 more QBs in the top 10: 2027 NFL Draft big board entering Week 1

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Arch Manning, Jeremiah Smith and 2 more QBs in the top 10: 2027 NFL Draft big board entering Week 1
sources.description: Why is Manning No. 1? His progression as a player was overlooked last year, but his play, along with his tools, indicated a future No. 1 draft pick. There's a lot of hype, but he looks like he's worth it.
